name: blindspot
description: Tracks which lines of your diff your eyes have actually rested on, and tells you what you never read before you commit.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Review tracking works in Restricted Mode. The repository's .blindspot/config.json is ignored until the workspace is trusted.

commands.title: Blindspot: Review Blindspot (jump to next unread hunk)
Blindspot: Choose What the Diff Is Measured Against
Blindspot: Stop Measuring This File (forget its reading)
Blindspot: Complete Review (move baseline to HEAD)

blindspot.enabled.markdownDescription: Track review attention in this workspace. [Show Review Report](command:blindspot.showReport) opens the report panel.

blindspot.reviewThresholdPoints.description: Evidence points a line needs before it counts as reviewed. Defaults to 3 = visible + focused + one pause.

blindspot.dwellMs.description: How long the viewport must hold still before a visible line earns a dwell point.

blindspot.visibleMsForPoint.description: Milliseconds a line must be on screen to earn the visibility point.

blindspot.focusedMsForPoint.description: Milliseconds a line must be on screen in the active, focused editor to earn the focus point.

blindspot.focalModel.description: Weight screen time by distance from the reader's focus (the caret, or the mouse when it moved more recently) instead of crediting every line in the viewport equally. Off = the flat viewport model.

blindspot.focalSpanLines.description: Lines either side of the focus that receive full attention credit.

blindspot.focalDecayLines.description: Distance from the focus at which attention credit bottoms out.

blindspot.peripheralFloor.description: Smallest share of a tick a line far from the focus can earn.

blindspot.contentScaling.description: Scale the time thresholds by how many tokens a line carries, so a closing brace does not cost the same as a dense expression.

blindspot.revisitGapMs.description: Time away after which returning to a line counts as re-reading it.

blindspot.readAckMs.description: Focused time on a line before it counts as read. Credit grows linearly up to this; a line that merely flashed past earns almost nothing.

blindspot.focusCapMs.description: Focused time per line after which focus credit stops growing.

blindspot.idleAfterMs.description: With no caret, scroll, mouse rest or edit for this long, time on screen stops counting as reading.

enumDescriptions: Diff in a git repository; reading anywhere else.
The lines you changed: the working tree since the last completed review, or since blindspot.baseRef. Needs git.
Every line of every file you have opened in this folder. Needs no git.
blindspot.mode.description: What Blindspot measures. Switch from the report panel, the status bar tooltip, or `Blindspot: Switch Mode`.

enumDescriptions: Everything since the commit the last completed review ended at, commits included. Until a review has been completed, blindspot.baseRef.
Always the working tree against blindspot.baseRef.
blindspot.diffSince.description: In diff mode, what the diff is measured against.

blindspot.readingSpeedGuard.description: Discard visibility credit when the viewport is moving faster than a human can read (fast scrolling).

blindspot.maxLinesPerSecond.description: Scroll speed above which lines earn no visibility credit.

blindspot.showStatusBar.description: Show live diff coverage in the status bar.

blindspot.explainOnHover.description: Hovering an unread line explains which review signals it did and did not earn.

blindspot.decorateUnreviewed.description: Mark unread lines with an orange bar in the gutter. The code itself is never recoloured.

blindspot.baseRef.description: Git ref the diff is measured against.

blindspot.refreshIntervalMs.description: How often the diff and report are recomputed.

blindspot.warnOnCommitBelow.description: Show the pre-commit warning when review coverage drops below this percentage.

colors.description: Overview-ruler marker for changed lines you have not read (diff mode).
Overview-ruler marker for lines you have not read yet (reading mode).

scripts.demo:html: npm run build && node out/demo/simulate.js --html demo/report.html
scripts.demo:page: npm run build && node out/demo/simulate.js --page demo/index.html
